title: Schema-first DSL linter with staged autofix and contextual warnings for routing rules
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Current routing-rule DSL validation is fragmented: runtime rejects some configs only at execution time, existing linters emit terse errors, and large org migrations cause prolonged rollbacks. Goal: Implement a schema-first linter that (1) validates routing DSL at commit time using a typed schema, (2) surfaces contextual human-readable warnings and suggestions, and (3) offers a staged autofix engine that proposes deterministic, reviewable fixes for common migration smells (region->regionId normalization, tier precedence inversion, variant aliasing). Non-goals: full policy transpiler or runtime execution replacement. Approach: adopt a canonical JSON/YAML schema derived from the typed AST, add layered validation passes (structural, semantic, safety), and embed a ruleset of fixers that run in dry-run mode producing patch suggestions. Deliverables: CLI linter (redwood-policy-lint), VS Code extension hints, GitHub action for pre-merge checks, staged autofix patches (git-friendly), and a compatibility report generator summarizing potential runtime fallback paths and risk score per change.
acceptance_criteria: CLI linter validates all existing routing configs under infra/policies/ and exits non-zero for structural/schema violations
Linter produces contextual warnings with examples and links to remediation steps for at least 10 common misconfig patterns
Autofix mode generates git patch files that apply cleanly for 80% of non-breaking normalizations in our test corpus
GitHub action blocks merges on high-risk schema changes unless an approver label is present
VS Code language hints display the top-3 warnings inline for DSL files and offer quick-fix suggestions

notes_or_updates: 2025-11-13 - Kickoff: alignment meeting with Runtime and Console teams. Agreed to keep linter output as advisory for two cycles before strict blocking.
2025-11-20 - Spike results: typed AST -> schema mapping covers 92% of constructs; region aliasing and tier inheritance need special-casing.
2025-11-27 - PR #84 opened for CLI skeleton and base schema. Internal lint run against corp repo found 1,140 stylistic warnings and 38 medium-risk semantic issues.
2025-12-01 - UX review with Developer Experience. Decided autofix will require commit message prefix 'policy-autofix:' and will surface a human-reviewed diff in PR comments.
2025-12-03 - Security review queued; early notes request proof that autofix cannot change runtime semantics (we will ship dry-run and require explicit opt-in for apply).
Action items: add deterministic ordering to fixes, craft migration playbook for large orgs, and expose a fallback-compatibility score in the Console rollout UI.
